answer: Proposal: weight identities by measured sustained capacity. Rotated random peers probe endpoints with signed streams; the ledger caps weight at sustained rate, sorted into terrace bands; a gale of bursts wins nothing. One link fronts N clone keys, but a pipe is conserved: N weights sum to one pipe, reef rock bounding a harbor; splitting adds nothing. Real weight needs real links, cost linear in N; farms lose while a link's lifetime reward stays below its rental over that horizon. Limit: colluding samplers inflate readings; rotation and cross-checks merely shrink that trust.
